{{Quote|Knowledge is power|Aic's motto|<ref name="Inside Attack of the Clones">{{InsiderCite|66|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones'': Geonosian War Chamber}}</ref>}}
The '''Aic''' was an intelligence and assassination network that worked with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the early days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Aic fed important information to the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] of the [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]] war room, including information that was useful during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].
